title: Bugfix: Bussi dynamics would crash with GPAW
body:
The Bussi dynamics would crash with GPAW, with the error ``Mismatch of Atoms objects``.

In Bussi dynamics the velocity is rescaled, the rescaling factor has a stochastic component.  That component is calculated from two random numbers (drawn from different distributions), but only one of these was broadcast to all nodes - the other random number would differ between MPI tasks, leading to the atomic positions diverging.

This bug fix communicates both numbers (in a single MPI broadcast call).
